correctness.rationale: The re-audited claim in repairs/2/RESULT.md assumes i.i.d. continuous ranks and defines ν consistently. Conditional on the peak priority, sorted admissible priorities on the two sides have factorial denominators; summing their count split gives the binomial in the excursion kernel. The triangular substitution yields mean defect a_i/(i+3) per site. At K₀, coincident equal gaps and the two shared-endpoint offsets have unchanged weights; different endpoint pairs require two separating arcs of length at least 2, hence exactly 2 each. The two conventional boundary offsets collide and the surviving joint probability is the four-kernel trace with M twice. Single means are unchanged, and expanding M−u⊗u yields the exact covariance defect. Positivity follows from the pointwise kernels, including the diagonal case, and does not presuppose operator definiteness of A_i. This also independently checks the slope by disjoint-window cancellation above the threshold. The supplied finite fractions and quadrature are diagnostic; the scripts were inspected, not executed.

value.rationale: The surviving correction proves the optimal exact-linear covariance and variance thresholds uniformly in both gap lengths, closing the specific all-index gap left by the source's experiments. The explicit positive bridge trace explains why neither mixed nor diagonal boundary deviations can cancel. It adds finite-size structure, not just more computed examples or a second derivation of known mean sharpness.
